author: SocialAPIs
description: Facebook & Instagram data for AI agents: pages, posts, groups, Ads Library, Marketplace, profiles and reels. 12 read-only tools (47 actions) with structured output. Requires a SocialAPIs API key (free tier: 200 calls/month at socialapis.io).
name: SocialAPIs — Facebook & Instagram Data

tools.name: facebook_page
tools.title: Facebook: Page
tools.description:
Facebook pages: profile details, page ID, posts, videos and reels.

Actions:
- action=details: Get a Facebook page's profile: name, category, follower and like counts, bio, contact info (email, phone, website, address), rating and the ad_page_id used by the Ads Library tools. Use it when you have the page URL; to find a page by name, use facebook_search (action=pages) first. Pricing: 1 credit per call; 5 credits when exact_followers_count=true. Requires: link.
- action=id: Resolve a Facebook page URL to its numeric page ID. Use it when another tool needs a page or profile ID; use action=details for the page's data. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: link.
- action=posts: List a Facebook page's recent posts, newest first, with text, media, reactions, comment and share counts. Returns 3-9 posts per call plus an end_cursor for the next page; filter by date with after_time / before_time. For reels or videos only, use action=reels or action=videos. Pricing: ceil(posts_returned / 3) credits per call, minimum 1. Requires: link.
- action=videos: List videos uploaded to a Facebook page, with video_id, title, duration, view count and thumbnail. Provide the page URL (link) or its numeric profile_id. Returns an end_cursor for the next page. For short-form reels, use action=reels. Pricing: 1 credit per call.
- action=reels: List a Facebook page's reels (short-form videos). Returns an end_cursor for the next page. For long-form videos, use action=videos. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: link.

action.description: Which operation to run. See the tool description for what each action returns and which parameters it needs.

link.description: For details, posts, videos, reels: Facebook page URL. For id: Facebook page URL (e.g., https://facebook.com/nike).

exact_followers_count.description: For details: When true, performs a deeper scrape to return the exact follower count (e.g. 38,493,217 instead of "38M"). Charges 5 credits when true, 1 credit otherwise. Default: false.

limit.description: For posts: Maximum number of posts to return. Default: 3. Minimum: 3. Maximum: 9. For videos: Maximum number of videos to return. Default: 6. Minimum: 6. Maximum: 12.

end_cursor.description: For posts: Pagination cursor for next page of results. For videos, reels: Pagination cursor.

after_time.description: For posts: ISO 8601 timestamp - only return posts after this time.

before_time.description: For posts: ISO 8601 timestamp - only return posts before this time.

timezone.description: For posts: Timezone for timestamps (e.g., UTC, America/New_York).

profile_id.description: For videos: Facebook profile ID (alternative to link).

tools.name: facebook_group
tools.title: Facebook: Group
tools.description:
Public Facebook groups: details, group ID, posts and videos.

Actions:
- action=details: Get a public Facebook group's profile: name, description, member count, privacy, rules and activity stats. Use action=posts for its posts. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: link.
- action=id: Resolve a Facebook group URL to its numeric group ID. Use action=details for the group's data. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: link.
- action=posts: List recent posts from a public Facebook group, with text, media, author, reactions and comment counts. Returns 3-9 posts per call plus an end_cursor for the next page; filter by date with after_time / before_time. Pricing: ceil(posts_returned / 3) credits per call, minimum 1. Requires: link.
- action=videos: List videos posted in a public Facebook group, with video_id, title, duration, view count and thumbnail. Returns an end_cursor for the next page. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: link.

tools.name: facebook_post
tools.title: Facebook: Post
tools.description:
Facebook posts, videos and comments: post details, attachments, comments and replies.

Actions:
- action=details: Get a Facebook post's text, author, timestamp, media, and reaction, comment and share counts. Start here for any post. If you need view counts, video download URLs or audio metadata (common for reels and videos), use action=details_extended instead. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: link.
- action=details_extended: Get everything action=details returns plus view counts, HD/SD video URLs, music/audio metadata and author verification status. Use it for reels and video posts, or when the standard details lack view_count, video_hd_src or attached_track. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: link.
- action=id: Extract the numeric post ID from a Facebook post URL. Use it to get the post_id that action=attachments needs. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: link.
- action=attachments: List every media attachment (images and videos, with URLs and dimensions) on a Facebook post, including all items in multi-photo posts. Needs the numeric post_id from action=id. For the post's text and engagement, use action=details. Pricing: 5 credits per call (deeper scrape than standard post details). Requires: post_id.
- action=video: Get a Facebook video post's metadata: title, message text and hashtags, owner, reactions and view count. Needs the numeric video_id (the number in a facebook.com/.../videos/<id> URL, or from facebook_page (action=videos)). Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: video_id.
- action=comments: List top-level comments on a Facebook post or reel, with author, text, timestamp and reaction count. Returns up to 30 per call plus an end_cursor for the next page. Set include_reply_info=true to get the comment_feedback_id and expansion_token that action=comment_replies needs. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: link.
- action=comment_replies: List replies to one Facebook comment. Needs comment_feedback_id and expansion_token, which action=comments returns when called with include_reply_info=true. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: comment_feedback_id, expansion_token.

tools.name: facebook_search
tools.title: Facebook: Search
tools.description:
Search Facebook by keyword: pages, people, posts, videos and locations.

Actions:
- action=pages: Find Facebook pages by keyword (brand, business or topic name), optionally near a location. Returns page names, URLs, categories and follower counts, 3 per call, plus an end_cursor. Use it when you don't have the page URL; then call facebook_page (action=details) with a result's URL. For locations, get a location_uid from action=locations. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: query.
- action=people: Find public Facebook profiles by name or keyword, optionally near a location (location_uid from action=locations). Returns names, profile URLs and pictures, plus work, education and location where public, and an end_cursor. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: query.
- action=posts: Search public Facebook posts by keyword, optionally filtered by location (location_uid from action=locations) and date range. Returns posts with text, author and engagement, plus an end_cursor. To list one page's posts, use facebook_page (action=posts) instead. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: query.
- action=videos: Search public Facebook videos by keyword, optionally most recent first or live videos only. Returns video titles, URLs and view counts, plus an end_cursor. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: query.
- action=locations: Look up Facebook places by name (city, region, venue) and get their location_uid. The location_uid is only used to filter action=pages, action=people and action=posts; it is not a Marketplace location (use facebook_marketplace (action=city_coordinates) for that). Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: query.

query.description: For pages: Keyword to search for, e.g. a brand or business name. For people: Name or keyword to search for. For posts: Keyword or phrase to search post text for. For videos: Keyword or phrase to search videos for. For locations: Search query (city, place, landmark).

location_uid.description: For pages: Location UID for filtering (from search/locations endpoint). For people, posts: Location UID for filtering.

end_cursor.description: For pages, people, posts, videos: Pagination cursor.

end_time.description: For posts: Filter posts before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

most_recent.description: For videos: When "true", shows most recent videos first.

videos_live.description: For videos: When "true", filters for live videos only.

fields.description: For videos: Comma-separated list of response fields to include.

tools.name: facebook_ads
tools.title: Facebook: Ads
tools.description:
Meta Ads Library: search ads, find advertisers by keyword, advertiser page details, single ad details and supported countries.

Actions:
- action=search: Search ads in the Meta Ad Library. Pass a keyword (query) to find ads about a topic, or ad_page_id to list one advertiser's ads; filter by country, active status and date range, sort by impressions or recency. Returns ads with creative, body text, dates, platforms and snapshot URL, plus an end_cursor. Get an advertiser's ad_page_id from action=keywords or facebook_page (action=details). Pricing: 1 credit per call.
- action=keywords: Find advertisers running ads that match a keyword: returns Facebook pages with their page_id and ad count. Use it to discover who advertises on a topic, then pass a page_id to action=search (as ad_page_id) or action=page_details. To get the ads for a keyword directly, use action=search. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: query.
- action=page_details: Get an advertiser's Ads Library profile: page name, verification status, category, location and total ad count. Needs the page ID (ad_page_id from facebook_page (action=details) or page_id from action=keywords). To list the ads themselves, use action=search with ad_page_id. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: page_id.
- action=archive_details: Get one Ad Library ad in full: creative, body text, CTA, platforms, countries, date range, and spend and impression estimates where Meta publishes them. Needs the ad_archive_id from a action=search result. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: ad_archive_id.
- action=countries: List the country codes the Ads Library tools accept in their country parameter. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tools.name: facebook_marketplace
tools.title: Facebook: Marketplace
tools.description:
Facebook Marketplace: search listings, vehicles and rentals, listing and seller details, categories and city coordinates.

Actions:
- action=search: Search general Facebook Marketplace listings (items for sale) by keyword or category near a location, with price, condition, radius and sort filters. Returns listings with their listing_id, plus an end_cursor. For cars and other vehicles use action=vehicles; for homes and rooms to rent use action=rentals. Get coordinates from action=city_coordinates. Pricing: 1 credit per call.
- action=vehicles: Search Facebook Marketplace vehicle listings (cars, trucks, motorcycles) near a location, with price, radius and seller-type filters. Returns listings with title, price, mileage, year and listing_id, plus an end_cursor. For non-vehicle items, use action=search. Pricing: 1 credit per call.
- action=rentals: Search Facebook Marketplace rental listings (apartments, houses, rooms) near a location, with price, bedroom, bathroom and radius filters. Returns rental listings with their listing_id, plus an end_cursor. For items for sale, use action=search. Pricing: 1 credit per call.
- action=listing: Get one Marketplace listing in full: title, price, description, condition, all photos, location and seller. Needs the listing_id from a Marketplace search result. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: listing_id.
- action=seller: Get a Marketplace seller's profile: name, join date, rating, review count and badges. Needs the seller_id from action=listing. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: seller_id.
- action=categories: List Marketplace categories with their IDs and category_url values. Use a category_url to filter action=search. Pricing: 1 credit per call.
- action=city_coordinates: Convert a city name to the latitude and longitude that the Marketplace search tools expect in filter_location_latitude / filter_location_longitude. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: city.

tools.name: instagram_profile
tools.title: Instagram: Profile
tools.description:
Instagram profiles: details, user ID, posts, reels, highlights and highlight stories.

Actions:
- action=details: Get an Instagram profile by username: bio, follower and post counts, verification status and related profiles. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: username.
- action=id: Resolve an Instagram username or profile URL to its numeric user ID. Needed by action=reels and action=highlights. Pricing: 1 credit per call.
- action=posts: List an Instagram profile's posts (photos, videos, carousels) with captions, like and comment counts and media URLs. Pass username (returns more results) or user_id. Returns an end_cursor for the next page. For reels only, use action=reels. Pricing: 1 credit per call.
- action=reels: List an Instagram profile's reels with play counts, captions, video URLs and audio metadata. Needs the numeric user_id from action=id. Returns an end_cursor for the next page. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: user_id.
- action=highlights: List an Instagram profile's story highlights with titles, cover images and highlight IDs. Needs the numeric user_id from action=id. Use action=highlight_details to get the stories in one highlight. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: user_id.
- action=highlight_details: Get the stories inside one Instagram highlight. Needs a highlight_id from action=highlights. Pricing: 1 credit per call. Requires: highlight_id.

username.description: For details, id: Instagram username. For posts: Instagram username (recommended — returns more results).

link.description: For details: Instagram profile URL (alternative to username). For id: Instagram profile URL.

user_id.description: For posts: Instagram user ID (alternative). For reels, highlights: Instagram user ID.

end_cursor.description: For posts, reels: Pagination cursor for next page.

highlight_id.description: For highlight_details: Highlight ID (from profile highlights endpoint).

tools.description:

Actions:
- action=feed: Get Instagram's recommended and trending reels. Pass clips_media_id from a previous result to continue the feed or get similar reels by the same author. Not tied to a user; for one profile's reels use instagram_profile (action=reels). Pricing: 1 credit per call.
